caption: A bright, open-plan living room with light beige carpet and white walls decorated with framed photographs and a round clock. In the foreground stands a black metal rolling cart holding a white plastic laundry basket, with a folded patterned blanket resting on its top shelf. Surrounding it are tan leather sofas and armchairs, a large flat-screen television on a black media console displaying a blue broadcast, and a dark blue exercise ball on the floor. In the background an open kitchen with light wooden cabinets and a dining table with black chairs is visible, all lit by soft, even daylight.
